entryPatches.appendInstructions: For the affected rewards without relying on this coordinate conflict, use Flowbermeow for Faith, the Moogle Shop at LV8 for Curaga, and Escarglow for Second Chance; those entries give costs and access routes.
An alternative to Aura Lion is Escarglow B-6 (200 LP); follow its connected board route and level/link gates.
To avoid the Aura Lion transformation ambiguity, use the LV8 Moogle Shop route (1000 munny, or 800 during Bargain Flurry) or the listed Riku chest.
To avoid Jestabocky’s disputed A-3 connection, use a different listed provider, such as Meow Wow G-3 in Smart Cookie disposition. Stat Boosts need the provider in the party.
The uncertain A-3 edge need not hold up Magic Boost: Meow Wow G-3 (Smart Cookie) is an alternative. For Strongest Link, complete another fully connected board such as Meow Wow.

One complete board is enough. A practical choice is Meow Wow: raise it to level 25, buy all its nodes, and visit both Stray and Smart Cookie dispositions to expose the hidden branches. Use the Spirit disposition reference if petting is awkward.
entryPatches.basis: goal condition plus route recommendation based on complete board

entryPatches.appendInstructions: Known detours around missing direct petting instructions: Passionate → Reaper by rubbing wings, then Reaper → Groovy by rubbing face; Groovy → Reaper by rubbing legs, then Reaper → Passionate by poking tail. entryPatches.appendInstructions: For collecting a breed, prefer its marked recipe-item formula, whose intended-breed success is documented, rather than assuming an unreported alternative has 100% odds. Extra rank is useful but is not required just to own the breed. Check the creation preview before spending materials; train the created Spirit normally instead of relying on the malformed starting-level cells.
Acquisition is unaffected by the reload dispute. For combat, use the command when its deck recharge indicator is ready rather than planning a fixed 22- or 24-second loop.

Conservative access plan: win every other cup and reach Rush LV17, which satisfies both published thresholds. Check whether the cup opens sooner; LV17 is a planning ceiling for the conflicting requirements, not a newly verified minimum.
entryPatches.basis: conservative sufficient-condition inference from both published access claims

entryPatches.appendInstructions: Conservative plan: finish the encounter chain without loading a save between appearances. Let the timed escape carry damage forward; do not leave mid-fight. This avoids depending on the undocumented save/reload behavior.

Conservative plan: keep one instance of every breed on the same save, train each to its maximum affinity, and keep the trained instances until the award is visible. This avoids relying on released-instance or NG+ flag retention; it is not a claim that release necessarily erases progress.

Conservative target: improve the recorded scores across all 14 ordinary Sora/Riku Dive courses until their sum exceeds 7,500,000, then check the Trophy Shelf. Do not depend on replaying one easy course without improving its best. This approach covers both candidate interpretations; the hidden aggregation rule remains unverified.
entryPatches.basis: conservative sufficient-condition reasoning; not verification of internal counter

entryPatches.appendInstructions: Before the finale, retain a separate save and meet the trophy requirement. Give the three listed answers during the actual ending and check Theater afterward. If you answered incorrectly, a retained pre-finale save lets you repeat that known initial route. Theater credits replay is documented for letters only; recovery from an already-saved wrong answer without that backup remains unverified.
entryPatches.basis: precaution; does not certify an already-cleared-save retrigger

newReferences.name: Spirit disposition routes
newReferences.summary: Treats and known two-step petting routes avoid missing interaction cells.
newReferences.instructions: Feed Confetti Candy for purple eyes, Ice Dream Cone for yellow, Shield Cookie for blue, or Block-it Chocolate for green. Repeat as needed: a single treat does not guarantee a change. After a successful change, close and reopen the Spirit menu before trying another. Check the displayed disposition and then its Ability Link branch. Beatalike, Tubguin Ace and Woeflower entries include known two-step petting alternatives; no missing body part is guessed.

newReferences.name: Portal hunting
newReferences.summary: Use forecast, Reports and the expanded map to find active portals.
newReferences.instructions: Choose the correct character and world. Match the forecast enemy to the portal entries, then compare the still-needed numbers in Reports → Game Records → Link Portals. One enemy can describe several candidate areas, so inspect each matching area and its expanded mini-map. Use your configured map control on Steam; the HD guide labels the PS4 touchpad. Portal configurations change when you Drop, so an absent portal is not proof it was collected. Complete the earlier Specials to unlock that world’s last one. Bonus-objective rewards and first-clear rewards are separate; do not count a repeated clear as a new portal.
